content: Build AI influencer ad videos by following a production-style pipeline: AI influencer → Hero Frame → Storyboard → Seedance (instead of relying on a single prompt).
tips: Build AI influencer ad videos by following a production-style pipeline: AI influencer → Hero Frame → Storyboard → Seedance (instead of relying on a single prompt).
